semiconductor_relevance: High — Micro-Epsilon Taiwan specializes in high precision sensors and measurement solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Micro-Epsilon Taiwan is a leading provider of high precision sensors and measurement solutions, particularly for applications requiring accurate distance, displacement, and temperature measurements. Their products are essential for ensuring quality and precision in semiconductor manufacturing and inspection processes.
capabilities: Inductive sensors for non-contact measurement of displacement and distance
Confocal measurement systems for high precision distance and thickness measurements
Dimensional measurement and defect detection systems

regional_presence.Taiwan: Micro-Epsilon Taiwan operates as a daughter company of the Micro-Epsilon Group, focusing on high precision measurement solutions in the region.
